universal.zh: 量排氣裡剩多少氧，電腦靠它調整油量到理想空燃比。
universal.en: Measures leftover oxygen so the engine computer can trim fuelling to the ideal air–fuel ratio.

specific.zh: N20 前感知器是寬域型（待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 upstream sensor is a wideband type (unverified).

universal.zh: 裝在觸媒後面，只負責監看觸媒有沒有在工作。
universal.en: Sits after the catalyst and only monitors whether the catalyst is working.

universal.zh: 12V 鉛酸電瓶，供起動與所有電子系統。先拆負極、後裝負極，避免扳手碰到車身短路。
universal.en: The 12 V lead-acid battery for starting and all electronics. Negative off first and on last, so a slipped spanner cannot short to the body.

specific.zh: BMW 把電瓶放在行李廂右側地板下，用 AGM 電瓶（待查證）。換新後要用診斷電腦「註冊」，電腦才會用正確的充電策略；不註冊會縮短壽命。
specific.en: BMW puts the battery under the right boot floor and uses an AGM type (unverified). A new battery must be "registered" with a diagnostic tool so the charging strategy resets; skipping this shortens its life.

commonIssues.zh: 電壓不足：起動慢、各種隨機故障碼。
commonIssues.en: Low voltage: slow cranking and random fault codes.

universal.zh: 夾在負極上的小感知器，量電流、電壓與溫度，告訴電腦電瓶健康狀況。
universal.en: A small sensor on the negative post measuring current, voltage and temperature to report battery health.

specific.zh: IBS 壞了會誤報電瓶問題，或讓充電策略錯亂。
specific.en: A failed IBS gives false battery warnings or wrong charging.

universal.zh: 引擎的大腦：讀所有感知器，決定噴油、點火、氣門、渦輪壓力。
universal.en: The engine's brain: it reads every sensor and sets fuelling, ignition, valve timing and boost.

specific.zh: BMW 叫 DME（Digital Motor Electronics），在引擎室右後方的電子箱裡。和車身電腦綁定，換新要編程。
specific.en: BMW calls it DME. It lives in the E-box at the right rear of the engine bay, is married to the car and must be programmed if replaced.

warnings.en: Disconnect the battery before unplugging it.

consequence.zh: 帶電拔 DME 插頭可能燒壞電腦或留下一堆故障碼。
consequence.en: Unplugging the DME live can damage it or leave a pile of fault codes.

universal.zh: 告訴電腦兩根凸輪軸轉到哪，才能和曲軸訊號對出哪一缸該噴油、點火。
universal.en: Tell the computer where each camshaft is so it can pair with the crank signal and know which cylinder to fuel and fire.

specific.zh: N20 在氣門室蓋後端各一顆（待查證）。
specific.en: On the N20 one sits at the back of the valve cover for each cam (unverified).

commonIssues.zh: 故障碼 P0340 / P0365、起動困難。
commonIssues.en: Codes P0340 / P0365 and hard starting.

universal.zh: 鎖在缸體上的麥克風，聽到爆震就讓電腦延後點火。
universal.en: Microphones bolted to the block; when they hear knock the computer retards ignition.

specific.zh: 鎖緊扭力很重要（待查證），太緊太鬆都會誤判。
specific.en: Torque matters (unverified); too tight or too loose both give false readings.

universal.zh: 量冷卻水溫度，影響噴油、風扇與儀表水溫。
universal.en: Measures coolant temperature for fuelling, the fan and the gauge.

universal.zh: 機油壓力太低就亮燈；N20 機油泵可變排量，電腦也靠它調整。
universal.en: Lights the warning if oil pressure drops; the N20's variable oil pump is also controlled from its reading.
